question:
Three different positions of the same dice (figures 1, 2, and 3) are shown. Which digit is on the face opposite to the one having 5?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ada032530facff77455ef5c07cb19307fc5c19db54926bcba0f360b7ab2eab9d.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:- 

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

From the positions 1, 2, 3 of Dice the opposite faces identified as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de0b02c2b9dcdc0c557359f722ef26f93dec2a3ab5db48e7792ae4ff23962117.png] 

Logic : If two dice have the same two face value in the given image then the third number is opposite to each other.

In second and third dice.

Number 1 and 6 are common.

∴ Here, '4' is opposite face of '5'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"4".**
